name: Sacrifice ~Uzuki no Kubiwa~
original_name: サクリファイス　～疼きの首輪～
source:
Main character sneaks into a manor to help a girl captured by a demon. However, girl does not wish to return after being branded as a shame of the family. Hero decides to explore the mansion in search of ways to help out while avoiding the encounter with the demon.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角潛入宅邸，試圖救出被惡魔抓走的女孩。然而女孩被家族打上恥辱烙印後，不願再回到原來的地方。主角決定探索宅邸，尋找幫助她的方法，同時避開惡魔。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
